summary: HPS Real Assets Lending Co LP filed an 8-K on September 3, 2026 under Item 8.01 to report routine monthly distributions declared on August 31, 2026 for Series I and Series II limited partnership interests. Per-share amounts range from $0.0712 to $0.1035 across various share classes. Distributions are payable on or about September 30, 2026 to holders of record as of August 31, 2026, in cash or through the distribution reinvestment program. This is an ordinary current report of distributions, not a special-situation event.
